messages:
Alex: Quick sync — audit export contract for customer-facing logs. Two open items: how to represent delegated actions across RBAC (actor vs initiator) and how to redact KMS info while keeping triageable IDs. Any hot takes?

Marta: Agreed — exported events must never leak key material or full ARNs. We can emit alias + short fingerprint. Also +1 to explicit delegation fields so customers can see who triggered vs who executed.

Samir: Can we be precise on terms? propose: 'actor' = immediate principal performing RPC; 'initiator' = originator of intent (end-user/admin). This helps correlate automation and human actions.

Leah: Same. Also propose fields: auth_method, auth_hint for token/consent context. For batch ops, allow resources array + action_count.

eng-audit-bot: Current internal v1 snapshot: ```{
  "event_type": "string",
  "timestamp": "rfc3339",
  "principal": { "id": "string", "type": "user|service|api_key" },
  "resource": { "type": "string", "id": "arn:..." },
  "action": "string",
  "metadata": { ... }
}``` Note: v1 keeps full ARNs and a single principal field.

Marta: Proposed v2 (customer export) shape (high level): - top-level audit_version - actor (optional) - initiator (optional) - resources: [ {type,id} ] where id is either customer-visible id or opaque-hash - key_reference: { alias, key_fingerprint } (fingerprint = sha256 truncated 12 chars) - scope: { type, id } where id is deterministic salted hash - auth_method / auth_hint - action_count for batched ops

Samir: Edge-case: impersonation. We must surface when requests used impersonation tokens vs service accounts. Also add field 'delegation_chain' short array? keep length limit 3 to avoid large payloads.

Leah: We have a telemetry hashing util for scope id. Use same salt rotation policy. Document that salted id is customer-deterministic and reversible only by us for incidents (we keep mapping in internal store). For exports we only send salted id.

Yash (ops): Rollout ask: do dual-write for 30 days: emit both v1 and v2 top-level in the same envelope with audit_version tags. Downstream consumers opt-in. Also note retention rules: do not include email, IP, or user PII unless configured. Need an opt-in flag for rich exports.

Marta: For KMS — internal logs keep full ARN. Export replace ARN with: alias + fingerprint. Example: `key_reference: { "alias": "cust-prod-keys", "key_fingerprint": "3f2a9b7d4c1e" }`. No direct ARN, no material, no key metadata.

Alex: Quick example v2 export (minified for visibility): ```{
  "audit_version": "v2",
  "event_type": "kms.encrypt",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-14T18:12:03Z",
  "actor": { "id": "svc-123", "type": "service" },
  "initiator": { "id": "user-987", "type": "user" },
  "resources": [{ "type": "data_blob", "id": "blob-456" }],
  "key_reference": { "alias": "cust-prod-keys", "key_fingerprint": "3f2a9b7d4c1e" },
  "scope": { "type": "project", "id": "h1_9af3b2" },
  "auth_method": "oauth:consent_screen"
}```

Samir: Question on scope id format — prefer prefix to signal salted hash algorithm (e.g., h1_) so we can rotate to h2_ later.

Leah: Good call. Also add 'owner_id' optional field that customers can opt into if they want mapping back to their tenant ids. Default false.

Marta: Add redaction rules doc: export must strip email-like patterns from freeform metadata unless opt-in; IPs replaced with 0.0.0.0/0 placeholder unless opt-in. Also limit freeform 'metadata' size to 8KB.

Yash (ops): Testing: create an exporter test harness that validates both v1 and v2 envelopes, tests redaction rules, and verifies dual-write parity for common events. Include migration checklist: notify downstreams, update schema registry, bump exporter version, and set 30-day opt-in flag.

Alex: Tasks: 1) eng-security to finalize v2 spec doc + examples (Leah/Marta) 2) eng-audit to add dual-write + exporter config (Samir) 3) ops to implement test harness + rollout checklist (Yash) 4) Product to draft customer-facing FAQs about what fields appear in exports and opt-in controls (assigned to Marta).

Leah: I'll draft spec PR with concrete JSON schema (no nested opaque objects; arrays limited). Will add backwards compat notes and example transformations.

Samir: I'll prototype serializer that maps internal ARNs -> key_reference and computes scope hash. Will add unit tests for delegation chains.

Marta: I'll own customer docs & opt-in flags. Also will coordinate a legal review on export PII policy.

Alex: Cool. Follow-up sync in 48h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
